justice: Standard separated multi-lane design allocates independent space for pedestrians, bicycles and motor vehicles.
Flat and continuous sidewalks provide relatively good accessibility for all groups of people.
Reasonable right-of-way distribution of different travel modes improves overall travel equity and fairness.
safety: Central isolation guardrail completely separates opposite traffic flow to avoid head-on conflicts.
Physical separation of pedestrians, bicycles and motor vehicles greatly reduces traffic accident risks.
Standard road markings, wide sight distance and complete street lighting ensure high driving safety.
livability: Full-line mature street trees and green belts build high-quality urban green landscape corridor.
Large traffic flow of main road brings continuous noise impact on surrounding areas.
No rest seating and recreational facilities are arranged along the roadside.
sustainability: Dense roadside trees and layered green belts have excellent ecological benefits and heat island mitigation effect.
Independent pedestrian and non-motorized lanes effectively support low-carbon sustainable travel.
Main road hard pavement lacks sponge city rainwater management system.
aesthetics: Neat symmetrical road layout, uniform street lamps and lush greenery create beautiful city boulevard landscape.
Continuous tree canopy on both sides builds elegant and comfortable street visual impression.
Empty overhead gantry and monotonous sky reduce visual richness of the street.
comfort: Independent pedestrian zone and green isolation belt provide good psychological security and comfort.
Roadside vegetation effectively reduces noise and improves surrounding micro environment.
High-speed vehicle operation on the main road brings long-term noise discomfort.
walkability: Wide, flat and separated dedicated sidewalk greatly improves walking safety and experience.
Unobstructed walking route and good barrier-free performance ensure high accessibility.
Good green landscape environment enhances walking willingness and comfort.
bikeability: Special separated non-motorized lanes provide safe and independent cycling space.

Lack of cycling dedicated signs and resting service facilities along the line.
